comparison.objective: Syringe task seats a filled syringe flange in a pump slot and advances a driver to the plunger without dosing; candidate commissions and locks an impact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Syringe task tests whole-object pose alignment, sub-millimetre flange insertion, cradle seating, and gentle linear contact without plunger motion. Candidate tests small-tool insertion, setscrew torque, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and iterative adjustment from dynamic impacts. Alignment and force limitation are shared generic primitives only.
comparison.success_condition: Syringe success requires tight seating/alignment, driver contact held for 1 s, and no more than 1 mm plunger push, with failure for displacement or loss. Candidate requires two non-bottoming, non-overloading stops and post-lock retention. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, and drift thresholds; later syringe specs explicitly bound pose, motion, and contact.
comparison.reason: Precision loading with dose-prevention does not test rotational parameter tuning, fastener locking, or repeated dynamic-response validation.
